Tiferes joins image and language like two rays becoming one command, yet the Awtsmoos remains beyond both ray and plan; Awtsmoos.com can let the body itself explain the workflow without teaching text cluttering the land.

# Phase Two — Improved Design

Preferred design after critique:

- The Create body opens with one continuous `Media + Prompt` composer.
- Empty media board has one strong “Add image” action, one secondary “Library” action, and drag/drop language.
- Text-only remains possible: prompt is always available and never gated by media.
- Once an image exists, the media board expands naturally and the prompt copy becomes contextual.
- Existing role/mode state is reflected with small role badges and concise actions, not a separate large mode card.
- Mode selection remains available as a compact contextual strip below the prompt/media body.
- Assigned image tiles expose Replace and Remove as persistent touch targets.
- Additional images use a compact add tile inside the same board.
- Optional Director/Looks/Guide stay below as collapsed disclosures.
- Generate remains immediately beneath the composer and should feel like the natural conclusion of the single body.
- One ambient glass field contains media + prompt + mode, with internal seams instead of many outer cards.
- Image previews use aspect-ratio containers with `object-fit:cover`, but preserve access to full media metadata/role.
- Desktop uses a responsive grid; phone uses a vertical board without horizontal overflow.
- Reduced motion disables scan/aurora motion completely.
- Existing upload/replace/repository/transport logic is reused and verified rather than reinvented.
